subject: Architecture review — service connectivity & KV cache design
messages:
From: Sophie Reed <sophie@cloudgrid.com>

Cc: platform-eng <platform-eng@cloudgrid.com>
Date: 2026-11-28T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: architecture deep-dive on service connectivity and cache behavior

Hi Karthik and team,

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. Our platform engineering leads at CloudGrid would like a deeper architecture session focused on two items:

- service-to-service connectivity patterns (mTLS, ingress routing, cross-region failover)
- KV cache/embedding cache behavior and cold-start characteristics under bursty workloads

We'd like a 60–75 minute technical deep-dive with architecture diagrams and any pre-reads you can share. Proposed windows next week (PST):

- Tue 2026-11-30 10:00–11:15
- Wed 2026-12-01 14:00–15:15

Can you confirm availability and send an agenda + pre-read links (slides, infra diagrams) so our engineers can review? Also please include any required folks from your side (SRE/serving runtime lead).

Thanks — Sophie
Sophie Reed
Senior Platform Engineer, CloudGrid
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-28T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: architecture deep-dive on service connectivity and cache behavior

Hi Sophie — great to hear this would be helpful. We can run a focused session and will bring the serving runtime and SRE leads. Tentatively we can do Tue 11/30 at 10:00 PST. If that works for you, we'll lock it and circulate the agenda + pre-reads by EOD Monday.

Proposed 75-minute outline (draft):
1) 5m quick context and success criteria (Sophie/CloudGrid)
2) 20m service connectivity: routing, mTLS, and cross-region routing policies (Jonas)
3) 25m runtime internals: KV/embedding cache architecture, eviction/refresh strategies (Jasmine)
4) 15m operations and SLOs: cold-start mitigation, autoscale behavior, tracing hooks (Marissa)
5) 10m Q&A + follow-ups / mutual action items

Pre-reads we'll attach: short slide deck (agenda + 1-page runtime overview), system diagram (draw.io export), and a mutual action plan template for recording next steps.

I will attach the pre-reads and the meeting Zoom in a follow-up; Jonas, Jasmine, Marissa — please confirm you'll join the slot or flag if you need a different time.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Solutions Engineering, Redwood Inference
